name: Burgerberg Q-tarou
original_name: バーガーバーグ Q太郎
source: Q-taro is a second string baseball player and very proud of his strength. He grew up in an orphanage and got his very mixed dialect from there.
translation: Q-taro is a second string baseball player and very proud of his strength. He grew up in an orphanage and got his very mixed dialect from there.
